curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with awareness and escape routes, then belts and child seats, then signaling intent and the three collision escapes.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Drill the child seat age and height, rear-facing infants and the three escapes as high-yield cards.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the off-road recovery steps, the oncoming drifter response, then animals and horseback riders.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Separate the drifter response from the frightened animal response.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover when headlights must be on, the two dimming distances, auxiliary lights and parking lights.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Drill each distance with its situation.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk from night driving to fog, dust and smoke, then rain, hydroplaning, wet brakes and floods.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Drill low beams in fog, headlights with wipers and hydroplaning.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Low visibility and wet road scenarios.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach when to stay home, then gentle gas, brakes and turns, then where and when ice is worst.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Drill bridges freezing first and near-freezing slipperiness.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain what causes skids and how to recover, then chains, traction tires and the studded tire season.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Separate chains from traction tires and drill the studded tire dates.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Skid recovery and traction device scenarios.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec09-m01..sec09-m06; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
